definitions.explanation: The body of a deceased person. A respectful term used in formal and news contexts, treating the deceased with dignity.

examples.japanese: {遺体|いたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{遺体|いたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}された→引き渡す：12486_hikiwatasu⟧。
examples.english: The remains were handed over to the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{捜索|そうさく}→捜索：19220_sousaku⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山中|さんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行方|ゆくえ}{不明者|ふめいしゃ}→行方不明者：28538_yukuefumeisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺体|いたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The search team recovered the body of the missing person in the mountains.

notes:
A compound of {遺|い} (left behind, bequeathed) and ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body). The kanji {遺|い} carries the nuance of something left behind by the deceased.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺体|いたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}される→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧ (a body is found)
- {遺体|いたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to recover a body)
- {遺体|いたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{取|と}る→引き取る：06164_hikitoru⟧ (to claim/receive a body)
- {遺体|いたい}{安置所|あんちじょ} (morgue)
- ⟦{身元|みもと}→身元：15710_mimoto⟧⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺体|いたい} (unidentified body)

More respectful than ⟦{死体|したい}→死体：04032_shitai⟧, which is a neutral or clinical term for a dead body. {遺体|いたい} is the standard term used in news reports and official communications when referring to the deceased, as it acknowledges the person behind the body. ⟦{死体|したい}→死体：04032_shitai⟧ is used more in forensic, legal, or detached contexts.
